findings.claim: A resumable continuation can be accepted as a current durable write without named-campaign provenance, and recovery can then treat the missing campaign-source identity as a successful binding. This violates the named-campaign-only ownership and fail-closed source-binding requirements.
evidence: skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/append_metrics.py:610-619 computes named_campaign from campaign_source presence, but only uses it to require missing context for named writes; a resumable unnamed record with continuation_context falls through because the omission check applies only when resumable is false. The contradictory path checked was an accepted schema-v4 record with remaining work, valid continuation context, and no producer_metrics.campaign_source; validate_current_write accepted it.

skills/slice-supervisor/scripts/resume_campaign.py:66-81 compares both source values using .get, so an absent campaign_preflight.campaignSource equals an absent terminal campaign_source, after which the continuation is consumed. Read-only in-memory execution using the valid fixture shape from skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_append_metrics.py:21-103 returned resumable: true and next_slice_number: 2 for that source-less record.

skills/slice-supervisor/references/receipt-schema.md:104-107 requires current resumable continuation projection only for named campaigns and says other current outcomes omit it; lines 118-122 require campaign-source binding and fail-closed malformed state. The demonstrated fall-through contradicts both requirements.

skills/slice-supervisor/tests/test_append_metrics.py:477-504 covers the positive named-campaign requirement and nonresumable omission, but does not exercise the acceptance-critical contradictory case of a resumable unnamed write carrying continuation context.

limitations: Review was confined to the packet-listed snapshot artifacts and their in-snapshot import dependencies; Git history, the source repository, session logs, and the internet were not inspected.

Artifact SHA-256 values matched the case packet. The write-producing test suite was not rerun because the review required no filesystem mutation; the defect was reproduced with a read-only in-memory adversarial execution and bytecode generation disabled.
